messages:
Anjali: Quick note — proposing a small format refresh for ARB next week. Thinking 60m total: keep one deep review but add a 10m 'lightning triage' slot and move to a 2-week rotating facilitator instead of weekly. Thoughts? I can post a tiny poll.
Mike: +1 for lightning triage. Helps clear the RFC backlog. 2-week rotation sounds better for continuity.
Sasha: Can we also set a firm pre-read cutoff — people dropping slides minutes before is rough. 24h?
Lucas: 24h works. Also would like a 5m "hot corner" for urgent rollout checks.
Priya: I can volunteer to facilitate the next slot if we go 2-week rotation. Happy to take notes and follow-ups.
Kai: @Priya awesome — can you add links to the RFCs you're planning to queue? Also prefer keeping one long review (~25m) + two short checks.
Anjali: Proposed structure: 60m total = 25m deep review + 2x10m quick checks + 10m lightning triage + 5m admin/notes. Pre-read 24h. If we agree I'll update the recurring invite and rotate the facilitator list.
Lucas: Works for me. Also can we add an invite instruction: "Accept/Decline with a short agenda comment" so people call out what they want reviewed.
triage-bot: RFC queue summary: 6 items. Top: model-serving-routing-rfc (Lucas), compile-kernel-selector (Sasha), batching-policy (Mike), kv-cache-strategies (Anjali), rollout-fallbacks (Priya), perf-metrics-schema (Kai).
Mike: I'll bump batching-policy up if Priya is facilitating next.
Sasha: I will drop compile-kernel-selector pre-read by EOD tomorrow.
Anjali: Quick poll: react with :thumbsup: for 60m + 2-week rotation, :thumbsdown: to keep current cadence. Please vote by EOD.
Lucas: :thumbsup:
Priya: :thumbsup: — adding myself to calendar and will draft an agenda.
Kai: :thumbsup: I'll take notes that day.
Priya: Draft invite body (posting here so folks can copy/edit):
```
Agenda (60m):
- 25m deep review — model-serving-routing-rfc (owner: Lucas)
- 10m quick check — compile-kernel-selector (owner: Sasha)
- 10m quick check — batching-policy (owner: Mike)
- 10m lightning triage — open small diffs / rollouts / blockers
- 5m admin & action items
Pre-read: please add links and a 2-3 line summary 24h before meeting. If you need more than one deep slot, ping the facilitator.
```
Mike: Nice. Can we add a line about recording decisions/links in the meeting notes thread?
Priya: Yep — I'll create the notes doc and add a template link to the invite.
Anjali: Thanks all — majority thumbs up. I'll update the recurring event, rotate the facilitator roster to biweekly starting next meeting, and post the updated invite + notes template.
Sasha: Thanks — will finish the pre-read.
Lucas: Done, looking forward.
triage-bot: Reminder scheduled: post RFC queue snapshot 48h before meeting.
